claims.claim: Bitdeer reported on September 16 that its 9.5 MW A102 Malaysia AI facility was fully contracted ahead of energization with more than $800M expected revenue, and that its Johor AI Cloud capacity had expanded to 86.8 MW.

factors.name: AI infrastructure conversion
factors.basis: contracted GPU capacity and expanded powered footprint indicate conversion from mining/power assets toward AI infrastructure

risks.risk: AI contracts depend on facility energization, GPU deployment and customer performance; Bhutan expansion is only an LOI.

causalEdges.mechanism: existing energy infrastructure can be repurposed and contracted for high-density GPU workloads
causalEdges.falsifier: energization/deployment delays prevent contracted capacity from entering service

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration and realized margins on the new AI contracts require underwriting.

claims.claim: Bitdeer Q2 2026 revenue rose to $228.8M from $155.6M year over year, but gross profit swung to an $8.5M gross loss and net loss widened to $92.3M; adjusted EBITDA was $31.1M.

factors.name: financial execution
factors.basis: strong revenue and adjusted EBITDA improvement coexist with negative gross margin and a wider net loss

risks.risk: Rapid AI/HPC buildout while core economics are volatile can increase funding and execution risk.

causalEdges.mechanism: capital deployed into powered facilities and GPUs creates saleable compute capacity
causalEdges.falsifier: gross economics remain negative after AI facilities enter service

unknowns.unknown: The durability of adjusted EBITDA as AI Cloud becomes a larger mix is not yet established.
